title: helichrysum aureum var. monocephalum
intro: Helichrysum aureum var. monocephalum, commonly known as a single-headed yellow flower, is a variety of the Helichrysum aureum plant, a flowering perennial in the daisy family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, thanks to its ability to stimulate collagen synthesis and improve tissue repair. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum aureum var. monocephalum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects and have been studied for their potential medicinal applications.
